item.title: New DAPD Paper Targets Privilege Illusion in LLM Policy Distillation
item.summary: A new paper called DAPD (Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation), surfaced by AK on X, introduces a dual-anchored framework that targets "privilege illusion" in LLM distillation, claiming ~+2 point gains over prior methods across six benchmarks and model scales from 1.7B to 32B parameters.
